feedback: The confession follows the decisive pre-vote contradiction closely: Mona admits replacing the accepted toast with sealed water in her account. The service photograph already made that lie visible, so the reveal does not need a new forensic trick to identify her. Her statement that she took poison at the preview supplies a specific unobserved action, but it confirms the inferred method rather than rescuing an otherwise unsolvable accusation. The emotional focus on the claimants being damaged by their own advocate works better than another general denunciation of Grant. Chip and Barb also close their separate failures coherently. Mona's motive could have had more personal texture earlier, but the ending feels earned and proportionate.
